newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates rise slightly to 24.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates rise slightly to 24.25 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank rates closed slightly higher at 24.25 percent on Friday in what dealers said was a fairly normal volume of transactions.
"There were more takers than lenders between the banks and the volume of the deals was fairly normal," said Balazs Varga of Inter-Europa Bank.
The rate fluctuated as low as 23.50 percent bid but closed higher than Thursday's 24.00 percent close, dealers said.
Varga said market volume should remain stable until the central bank's one-month passive repos mature, bringing more money into the market. -- Budapest newsroom ++ 36 1 327 4040
